high harmonic generation from bulk crystals is anisotropic, and that this anisotropy is related to the interatomic potential of the crystal.

high harmonic generation ( HHG) in a solid is sensitive to inter atomic bonding, and that this sensitivity could enable the all-optical imaging of the inter-atomic potential and thus, the valence electron charge density, and perhaps, even wavefunctions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
high harmonic generation (or high harmonic emission) in crystals.
the development of new methods for probing the microscopic electronic properties of materials, and with the use of these techniques to investigate fundamental problems of condensed matter physics.
the generation of high harmonics in solids and their use to investigate the electronic properties of materials.

the anisotropic high harmonic emission is a direct consequence of the anisotropic valence electron density in a solid.
